title: Counter Price List for Navigation Units, Child Seats, Snow Chains and Ski Racks
content:
Four items of equipment are sold at the counter against a Wanderlane car rental. Two of them are priced for
each rental day and two for the whole rental, and the price is the one published by the rate class booked.
The list covers all six Car Rental Rate Classes.

| Rate class | Satellite navigation unit, per rental day, in USD | Child seat, per rental day, in USD | Snow chains, whole rental, in USD | Ski rack, whole rental, in USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 13.99 | 14.99 | 45 | 55 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 12.99 | 13.99 | 42 | 52 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 11.99 | 12.99 | 39 | 49 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 9.99 | 10.99 | 35 | 42 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 8.99 | 9.99 | 32 | 39 |

The first two columns are prices for a day and the last two are prices for a hire, however long it runs.
A child seat is priced for each seat, so a hire carrying two seats carries the per-day figure twice over.

On the Premium Inclusive Rate every one of the four figures is nothing, which is the class's published
price for these items and not a concession made at the counter.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

For a hypothetical hire of three rental days on the Inclusive Flex Rate taking one navigation unit, one
child seat and a ski rack: the navigation unit is priced at 9.99 USD for each of the three days, the child
seat at 10.99 USD for each of the three days, and the ski rack at 42 USD once for the hire. The same three
items on the Pay Now Saver Rate would be priced at 13.99 USD a day, 14.99 USD a day and 55 USD for the hire.
